nom: COSRX 6X Peptide Collagen Skin Booster Toner Serum for Dull Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin are split: one says it broke her out and didn't work for her, while others report it helps control sebum in the T-zone and suits oily, acne-prone skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one using it through a tretinoin peeling phase, consistently report strong hydration, soothing and a smoother, more radiant look.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report calming, non-irritating use and an improved moisture barrier, even on compromised or combination-sensitive skin, though one with combo/oily skin says it broke her out.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation, burning or redness and describe the formula as calming, but one reviewer developed white discoloration patches, hives and a rash on her neck and warns the product is not for sensitive skin.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal or normal-combination skin report the product boosts hydration and plumpness and improves how well products layered afterward perform.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their mid-40s to 80s report firmer, plumper skin with less noticeable fine lines and improved elasticity after weeks of consistent use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers, including several in their 40s to 80s, report firmer, plumper skin with less noticeable fine lines after weeks of use, though a couple caution it works gradually and is not a miracle worker for deep wrinkles on its own.
concerns.dehydration: Hydration is the most consistently reported benefit, with reviewers describing plump, soft, dewy skin from the first few uses; one reviewer notes it doesn't provide intense enough hydration alone for very dry skin and should be paired with a richer cream.
concerns.redness: Reviewers, including one with mild rosacea, report reduced redness and a more even tone, and one with an already compromised barrier says it caused no burning or redness; one reviewer, however, developed a rash and hives after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers report the formula feels calming and supportive of the skin barrier, including one who used it specifically to help repair a barrier compromised by another product, with no burning or redness on their sensitized skin.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report faded acne scars, hyperpigmentation or burn-related white patches and a more even skin tone with continued use, though one reviewer reports the opposite: new white discoloration patches appeared on her neck after starting the product.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some with oily or acne-prone skin, report no new breakouts, less sebum and calmer skin, but one reviewer with combination-oily skin says it broke her out and did not work for her.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin or an oily T-zone report the serum helps balance sebum production and absorbs without a greasy feel, though one reviewer says her face initially felt greasy before settling into a soft, moisturized finish.

aspects.libelle: Very watery, lightweight texture, absorbs almost instantly
Large bottle seen as strong value for the price
Layers well under other products without pilling
A few bottles arrived unsealed or looking watered-down
Bottle seen as cheap-looking or not travel-friendly

extraits.titre: Now I have discoloration marks and a horrible rash
extraits.texte: Not for sensitive skin! I started using this and got neck discolorations in the worst way possible but couldn’t figure out what was causing it. After trying everything in my routine on its own to see what was causing hives, discoloration and a bad rash, I finally realized this is it. My neck has this horrible white spots all over that still can’t get back to its original color. I don’t know if I got a bad product, if it’s my skin that didn’t tolerate it or what, but please beware.

I would recommend reading the ingredients before buying as always. I didn’t think this would hurt my skin but This definitely broke my skin out. I have combo/oily skin and I don’t have that sensitive of skin. Not saying this is a bad product, but it did not work for me. No refund option available either.

extraits.titre: Pores got smaller in the matter of days
extraits.texte: The first product that has ever actually worked for me as far as shrinking my pores. I have been looking for a while now for a product that can do just this. In just a few days I noticed a difference in my skin. I have combo/sensitive skin and I bought this bc I felt my barrier was ruined from a different product I had used. This product I read can help fix the skin barrier and more. I noticed it felt very calming on my skin when I applied it and did not burn/hurt my skin or cause any redness with my already compromised skin. i will continue to repurchase!!

extraits.titre: Significant improvement in my skin tone and textureSignificant improvement in my skin tone and texture
extraits.texte: I've been using this for well over a year and I use it after I get out of the shower in the morning, and at night when I wash my face. It allows for deeper penetration of other skin care products and I've noticed a huge difference in the texture of my skin as well. It is highly effective with no scent. I have a very mild case of rosacea (self diagnosed, lol). But this has made a significant difference in evening my skin tone and getting rid of the redness. I also apply it to my neck and chest area and have noticed a difference as well, in the way my other products work after applying it. Especially products used to lighten any dark spots like freckles etc. I've noticed a HUGE difference in that area. Because I am fair skinned, unfortunately I am prone to freckles since I was younger. So if I go out in the sun, I get sprinkled with freckles on my nose and upper cheeks as well as my chest and shoulders and although I use SPF, I do live in Florida and I've noticed since moving here from the north my skin looks so much worse. But when using this along with some other dark spot remover products it has made a huge difference in the way the products work! It's a very watery consistency but do not put it on a pad like you would for a toner this is not a toner you want it to absorb into your skin as much as possible. It is not thick at all it comes out basically like water and soaks right into your skin with a few light pads give it about a minute and you'll be ready to move on to you

In my search to address the extremely dry condition of my skin, I purchased this product. It is unscented, has a lightweight consistency, and is swiftly absorbed. It has a slight tightening effect on the skin, which feels pleasant. My skin now has a beautiful radiance and a notably smoother texture. I’ve noticed my large pores seem smaller too. I intend to purchase again as well as other COSRX products.

I'm almost 46 and have been a skin care girlie most of my life. I have never used a product that has impressed me and exceeded my expectations as much as this booster has. I use it daily-two pumps covers my whole face and neck. I've noticed a drastic improvement in my overall tone & texture, the few fine lines I do have seem to be less noticeable, my skin is soft and smooth and has the most beautiful radiance. It has also faded my hyperpigmentation due to PCOS. It isn't sticky, has no fragrance, and does not irritate my skin. I use this in the mornings, sometimes adding a pump of the snail mucin (which is also a game changer) before going in with VitC & Niacinamide, then a light moisturizer with SPF. My skin has genuinely never looked this good, and I find myself wearing way less makeup bc there isn't much to cover. This will be a holy grail in my skincare routine from now on.

Here are pros and cons for the COSRX Skin Boosting Serum with 6 Peptides: Pros: Lightweight, watery texture absorbs quickly without feeling heavy or greasy Packed with 6 different peptides to target multiple skin concerns Helps smooth and refine skin's texture over time Minimizes the appearance of fine lines and pores Boosts overall radiance and healthy glow Fragrance-free and non-irritating formula Simple to incorporate as the first step in a skincare routine Plays well when layered with other serums/moisturizers Cons: Results are gradual and subtle rather than dramatically transformative May cause slight pilling or balling up under heavier creams/makeup Doesn't provide intense hydration on its own for very dry skin types Pump bottle not ideal for getting out every last drop of product Limited third-party research on the effectiveness of the peptide blend Overall, I've been happy using this COSRX peptide serum so far. It delivers a nice skin-smoothing, pore-reducing, and radiance-boosting effect with consistent use. The lightweight formula is a dream for layering. However, managing expectations is important. This isn't a miracle worker that will erase deep wrinkles or discoloration. It's more of a daily skin-conditioning treatment to improve general complexion and texture over time.
